## Stage 4 Planning — FIXTURE producer surface (provenance-survival)

A Stage-4 planning sub-task comment that DID emit the provenance determination,
standing in for the normal spoke-authored path. Used by P3 (paired with
prov-conformant.md → delta PASS) and P4 (paired with prov-label-absent.md →
delta FAIL naming the lost element).

It carries Survival-Set rows 1 and 2 and deliberately not rows 3-5, so the delta
limb has a real denominator rather than an all-or-nothing one: P4 must report
domain_practice-label as lost while file-change-matrix survives. A comment that
carried every element would not distinguish "one element lost" from "everything
lost."
